stance_rationale: Alpha time-series artifact quality is acceptable, but PIT process integrity is not defensible: C15 is violated in executable code and C4/C14 controls are asserted but not enforced. Combined with failed robustness gates (sub_stability, DSR), the package cannot be approved.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is true monthly time-series (241 sig_dates, no future dates, regular 28-31 day spacing, variable ticker count). Separate integration risk remains: weights.csv is snapshot-only without sig_date.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: run_alpha_regime.R uses align_factor_direction() before scoring (line 113), with no explicit manual sign flip path.
No executable Usable_Date<=sig_date guard is implemented; only self-declared text claims C14 PASS.
run_alpha_regime.R directly enumerates factor_db_YYYYMM parquet files and read_parquet() (lines 81-99) instead of mandated load_month_factors() route.
Regime label is built at month_end and shifted to next-month sig_date (lines 257-264), satisfying t-1 application.
No explicit annual->May / quarterly->45d financial statement lag enforcement is visible in executable alpha construction.

critical_concerns.description: PIT-C15 hard violation: implementation directly loads factor_db parquet files (run_alpha_regime.R lines 81-99) while package claims C15 PASS, creating process/audit inconsistency.
C4/C14 are asserted but not code-enforced; no executable checks for statement-lag policy or explicit Usable_Date gating were found, so future-reference risk is unresolved.
Robustness gates materially fail (sub_stability=0.4183<0.50, DSR=0.0007<0.50), yet handoff narrative still leans on optimizer uplift; alpha reliability is fragile.
Single-sleeve long-only top-20 mechanism remains (alpha_vector has 20 names) with no AX-007 exception structure (multi-sleeve/LS/50+/ML sizing), while CRISIS composite IC is negative.
Reproducibility lineage is weak: required stage path A (/qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_007) is missing, and artifact_lineage reproduction_command references run_all.R that is absent.
weights.csv has no sig_date column and stores one CAUTION snapshot only, so independent walk-forward weight replay artifact is missing despite RF-A7 history risk.

supporting_arguments: Independent recomputation from alpha_scores.parquet reproduces full-sample rank_IC=0.048943 and ICIR=0.601994, matching package diagnostics.
Recent 3Y ICIR is 0.407793 (ratio 0.677x of full ICIR), so RF-A3 overfit pattern is not triggered.
Covariance matrix audit passes numerically (PSD true, min_eigen=0.002572299, condition_number=24.90906 <= 100), indicating risk-side matrix conditioning is not the blocking issue.
Alpha time-series dimension is valid (241 monthly sig_dates, 322623 rows, duplicate sig_date-ticker pairs = 0).
unresolved_disputes: Whether upstream factor_db generation already enforces C4/C14 strictly enough to compensate for missing runtime guards in this alpha script.
Whether direct parquet loading can be accepted as a C15 exception under current charter (text says no direct parquet load).
Whether snapshot-only weights artifact is acceptable for judge-level replay, given Iter-4 RF-A7 precedent.
Which canonical stage artifact root is authoritative for WT-D20260425_007: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-* or stage_artifacts/WT_D*.
weakest_assumption: Self-declared PIT compliance (especially C4/C14/C15) is assumed valid without enforceable runtime controls, despite direct factor parquet loading in the executable path.
rebuttal_required: Patch alpha build path to use mandated load_month_factors() only, and provide diff + rerun hashes proving C15 compliance.
Provide executable C4/C14 assertions (statement lag and Usable_Date checks) with failing unit tests on injected counterexamples.
Submit full walk-forward weight schedule artifact (sig_date,ticker,weight,regime) instead of snapshot-only weights.csv.
Re-run robustness with explicit multiple-testing accounting and show how DSR/sub_stability failures are resolved or downgraded with evidence.
rationalization_red_flags: near-match to banned minimization framing: "BULL/NORMAL에선 미미; ρ 차이 0.001"

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Cross-checks confirm strong headline IC metrics and valid time-series alpha shape, but PIT implementation integrity and robustness failures dominate; this is a process-validity rejection, not a performance-metric rejection.

alpha_specific_questions: C15 금지사항(직접 parquet 로드) 위반 없이 동일 성능을 재현할 수 있는가?
C4/C14를 코드 레벨 assert로 강제했을 때 rank_IC/ICIR/Harvey_t가 유지되는가?
AX-007 예외 구조(예: multi-sleeve 또는 50+ 분산) 없이 top-20 single-sleeve를 유지해야 할 근거가 무엇인가?
